subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'but' **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given blank requires a coordinating conjunction which will connect two contrasting ideas or events.
 
• The sentence suggests that even though there are lot of man-made litters on the road we just pass by without making any effort to clean up the mess.
 
• ‘But’ is a conjunction that connects the two contrasting events here, one is the heap of litter on the roads and the other is our disinterested attitude to clear up the same.
 
• Hence ** option 2 ‘but’ is the correct option.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ‘So’ is a subordinating conjunction used to indicate the result of something.
 
• ‘Only’ is an adjective that denotes very few.
 
• ‘Than’ is a conjunction that refers to a comparison between two things.

 
• Hence all other options are inappropriate to fill the given blank
